scope: Static code audit plus first follow-up execution after v39 shared app factory migration.
audit_findings: v39 left formatter, crypto-code, media, runtime, and text-reference batches on the older Shared.mount path.
ymir-vue-tools-app still wrapped itself with createConfiguredToolApp but mounted with raw createApp rather than the shared mount factory.
The shared factory did not yet support legacy template-based app options, which blocked full migration of remaining template-heavy batches.
A few browser/local wording fragments still existed in core tool metadata and status strings.
changes: Extended createConfiguredToolState to merge legacy data() output or data objects into configured app state.
Extended createConfiguredToolApp to support schema.template so old template-based batches can mount through the same factory path.
Migrated formatter, runtime, media, and text-reference batches from Shared.mount to Shared.mountConfiguredToolApp.
Migrated crypto-code dynamic multi-root mounting to Shared.mountConfiguredToolApp via Object.assign({root}, makeApp(...)).
Changed ymir-vue-tools-app to use mountConfiguredToolApp for the core tool app, keeping createApp only as a fallback.
Removed unused createApp variables from converter, dns, legacy, and reference batch scripts.
Updated resource query version from 20260531-v39 to 20260531-v46.
Cleaned remaining browser/local wording in core tool metadata and random-generator status text.

checks.node_check: passed for all ymir-vue scripts, home dashboard, i18n, ui, csp report, and skip-old-vercel-builds script
checks.vue_static_smoke: passed for all 12 Vue batch app scripts with mocked Vue and Element Plus runtime
checks.loader_mapping: 150 tool mappings, 12 script files, 0 missing script files
checks.shared_mount_residue: Shared.mount(...) not found in ymir-vue app scripts
checks.risk_phrase_residue: targeted legacy local/browser/no-upload phrases and eval(atob) not found
